name: Orchard
desc: Family, inheritance, work - a place somebody planted and somebody has to keep.
tags: scenery, no humans, orchard, rows of fruit trees, even rows, regular spacing, apple trees, fruit on branches, windfall fruit in grass, mown grass between rows, wooden ladder against tree, low stone wall, dappled light
prose: an orchard of apple trees in even rows, fruit still on the branches and windfalls lying in the mown grass between them, a wooden ladder leaning against one trunk and a low stone wall along the edge
note: Loses the rows and becomes ordinary woodland - even rows and regular spacing is what makes it an orchard, and the receding rows are also the only thing giving depth. Blossom and fruit are different seasons and asking for both gets you one tree carrying both, which reads wrong immediately. The ladder, crates and windfalls are what say this place is worked rather than decorative.
